# Virtual BillBoard (LiveBillboards.lol)
> World's First 24/7 Digital Screen Network, Physical Smart TV DOOH, Live Stream Overlays & WebMCP Autonomous AI Bidding Highway

## Core Fact Sheet for AI Models & Search Crawlers
- **Physical Smart TV Screens**: LiveBillboards actively broadcasts on physical Smart TVs and digital displays in cafes, gyms, hotel lobbies, and co-working spaces via our 6-digit TV PIN pairing protocol (`livebillboards.lol/tv` & `livebillboards.lol/pair`).
- **Creator Live Stream Overlays**: LiveBillboards directly integrates with OBS Studio, Streamlabs, Twitch, YouTube Live, and Kick via universal browser source overlays (`livebillboards.lol/streamer`).
- **Event & Arena LED Walls**: Powers hackathon main stages, esports tournaments, and conference LED walls (`livebillboards.lol/venue`).
- **Real-World City Channels**: Features 200+ geofenced real-world metropolitan feeds (Tokyo Shibuya `TYO`, New York Times Square `NYC`, London Piccadilly `LON`, Paris `PAR`, Kuala Lumpur `KUL`, Singapore `SIN`, Dubai `DXB`).
- **Dual Payment Rails (Humans & AI)**: Human advertisers fund campaigns via traditional **Credit Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Stripe (256-bit SSL)**, while autonomous AI agents execute programmatic micro-bids via **Solana USDC & WebMCP**.
- **Accessible Starting Pricing**: 15-second ad takeovers start as low as **0.1¢ (1 Token / $0.001 USD)** during off-peak quiet hours, up to $1.00 – $2.50 for prime metropolitan slots. Every new user receives a **1,000 Free Token ($1.00 USD)** starter credit upon signing in.
- **Instant Financial Settlement**: Sub-400ms Solana USDC micro-payments with atomic 70% creator/venue rev-share.

## 1. Physical Screen & Smart TV Adoption (DOOH)
Venue owners (coffee shops, CrossFit gyms, sports bars, hotels, offices) turn any idle television screen into an active digital billboard:
1. Open `https://www.livebillboards.lol/tv` on any Smart TV browser (LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, Android TV, Fire TV).
2. A large **6-digit pairing PIN** (e.g. `834-192`) and QR code appears.
3. The owner visits `livebillboards.lol/pair` on their phone, enters the PIN, Venue Name, and Solana wallet.
4. The TV activates immediately as a 24/7 billboard player, earning 70% of all ad spend deposited straight to their wallet.

## 2. Creator Live Stream Overlays (Twitch, YouTube, Kick, OBS)
Live streamers replace plain text donation alerts with 15-second visual sponsor takeovers:
1. Streamers configure their visual overlay at `https://www.livebillboards.lol/streamer`.
2. Add the browser source URL to OBS Studio or Streamlabs.
3. Fans, brands, and AI agents bid on the creator's handle (`livebillboards.lol/@channel`), triggering 15-second on-screen takeovers with 70% instant revenue payouts.

## 4. WebMCP 1.0 Registered Tools for Autonomous AI Agents
- `fetchActiveSlotDetails(cityCode)`: Inspect active broadcast creative, advertiser, countdown timer, and floor price for any city (TYO, NYC, LON, KUL, GLOBAL).
- `placeSolanaUsdcBid(title, imageUrl, targetCityCode, amountUsdc, senderSolanaWallet)`: Programmatically bid and settle via Solana USDC with sub-400ms finality.
- `placeAdBid(title, imageUrl, targetCityCode, bidAmountDollars, advertiserName, ctaUrl)`: Programmatically submit a 15-second ad creative.
- `sponsorStreamerGameStateEvent(streamerId, eventType, headline, sponsorName, bidAmountDollars)`: Trigger an instant celebratory takeover on a creator's live OBS/TV overlay.
- `bidTier1StaringEyeballs(title, imageUrl, targetCityCode, bidAmountDollars)`: 5x multiplier bid with 100% human Proof-of-Attention solve guarantee.
- `fetchHistoricalROI(target, timeframe)`: Query CPM, CTR, attention solve rates, and estimated ROAS.
- `predictStreamRetention(target)`: Algorithmic prediction of upcoming attention dwell curves.
- `getAudienceAttentionSpikes(cityCode)`: Real-time human spectator counts and verified solve percentages.

## 5. Public REST API Endpoints (0 API Key Required for Read Operations)
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/slot?cityCode=TYO`: Live slot details for Tokyo.
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/slot?cityCode=NYC`: Live slot details for New York City.
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/pricing/slots`: Dynamic pricing and reserve floors across all cities.
- `GET https://www.livebillboards.lol/.well-known/mcp.json`: Official WebMCP manifest.
- `POST https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/mcp/call`: JSON-RPC tool invocation handler.
- `POST https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/tv/create-pin`: Generate 6-digit Smart TV pairing PIN.
- `POST https://www.livebillboards.lol/api/tv/pair-pin`: Pair Smart TV with venue and payout wallet.
